Our product lines include Point of Care, Immunoassays, Molecular Diagnostics and Animal Health.

These products are used in hospitals, clinical laboratories, physician offices, blood banks,
pharmacies and veterinary clinics.

[ACON's Story][27]

### Our Brands

#### Blood Glucose Meter Systems

Carefully designed for accuracy and reliability, the *On Call*^{®} Blood Glucose Meter Family has
helped millions of patients worldwide effectively manage their glucose levels.

[View Product Line][28]
[Mission POCT]

#### Point-of-care testing (POCT)

Our product offering includes a variety of urine reagent test strips, urine analyzers and handheld
devices for the measurement of cholesterol, coagulation and hemoglobin. 

[View Product Line][29]
[HealthyMe Logo]

#### Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)

ACON Labs has been the leading UTI manufacturer in the US. The HealthyMe Urinary Tract Infection
reagent strips are highly reliable and easy to use.

[View Product][30]
[ACON Laboratories, Inc]

#### Lateral Flow Rapid Tests

Reliable qualitative screening for Pregnancy, Cancer Markers and Infectious Disease including our
SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) antibody test.

[View Product Line][31]
[Mission POCT]

#### Our Newest Brand

Flowflex^{TM} is the newest brand addition to the ACON product portfolio.  The Flowflex SARS-CoV-2
Rapid Antigen Test is the first in this family of lateral flow testing products.

[View Product][32]
[Mission POCT]

#### Pregnancy Rapid Tests

Rapid chromatographic immunoassays for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin
(hCG) in urine. 

[View Product Line][33]
[Mission POCT]

#### Allergen Test Kit

This tried-and-true immunoblot assay tests for 30 allergens on one strip.

[View Product Line][34]

#### Molecular Diagnostics

Nucleic Acid Extraction System and PCR quantitative test kits for HBV, HCV, HPV 16/18, HPV
Genotyping, TB and HLA-B27.

[View Product Line][35]
[CentriVet Logo]

#### Animal Health

Our product offering includes a dual Ketone/Glucose meter, as well as urine reagent test strips.

[View Product Line][36]

# Advancing science.
# Amplifying impact.

[ What We Do ][201]

Grifols is a leading global healthcare company. Our trusted and innovative plasma-derived medicines,
other biopharmaceuticals and solutions in transfusion medicine enable millions of patients around
the world to lead more productive lives.

Since our founding in 1909, our ever-growing mastery of plasma, diagnostics and life sciences,
backed by our ethical leadership and industry-leading quality and safety standards, have contributed
to a healthier and more sustainable society.

## TIME and Forbes rank us among the world’s best companies

TIME magazine has recognized Grifols as one of the world’s top companies for the third consecutive
year. Additionally, for the second year in a row, Forbes has named Grifols one of the World’s Best
Employers.

This achievement reflects our relentless commitment to our people and long-term impact.

## Latest news

immunoglobulins

alpha1-antitrypsin deficiency

June 29, 2026

Read Release

## Barcelona honors Víctor Grífols i Lucas

The Barcelona City Council has named the street where the company’s institutional headquarters is
located after Víctor Grífols i Lucas. This tribute recognizes a pioneer in the biomedical industry
who, for more than six decades, was the heart and driving force behind Grifols. Uncover the story
behind Grifols’ legacy.

[ Read more ][206]

## Commitment to people and the planet

Aligned with the United Nations plan to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals defined in its
2030 Agenda, we work every day to do more and do better to contribute to the health and quality of
life of people around the world.

The patients we serve are able to lead better lives. Patients inspire the work we do every day.

[ Read more ][207]
Innovation

## Scientific innovation at work

Our deep and expanding knowledge of plasma and the life sciences is helping us better understand
human health and research potential treatments to improve it.

[ Read more ][208]

## Get to know us

Our history

We trace our roots back to 1909 when Dr. Josep Antoni Grifols i Roig founded a clinical analysis
laboratory in Barcelona, the precursor to Laboratorios Grifols.

Grifols' mission, to improve people's health and well-being, has patients, donors and society at the
heart of everything we do.

# Advancing science.
# Amplifying impact.

[ What We Do ][201]

Grifols is a leading global healthcare company. Our trusted and innovative plasma-derived medicines,
other biopharmaceuticals and solutions in transfusion medicine enable millions of patients around
the world to lead more productive lives.

Since our founding in 1909, our ever-growing mastery of plasma, diagnostics and life sciences,
backed by our ethical leadership and industry-leading quality and safety standards, have contributed
to a healthier and more sustainable society.

## TIME and Forbes rank us among the world’s best companies

TIME magazine has recognized Grifols as one of the world’s top companies for the third consecutive
year. Additionally, for the second year in a row, Forbes has named Grifols one of the World’s Best
Employers.

This achievement reflects our relentless commitment to our people and long-term impact.

## Barcelona honors Víctor Grífols i Lucas

The Barcelona City Council has named the street where the company’s institutional headquarters is
located after Víctor Grífols i Lucas. This tribute recognizes a pioneer in the biomedical industry
who, for more than six decades, was the heart and driving force behind Grifols. Uncover the story
behind Grifols’ legacy.

[ Read more ][206]

## Commitment to people and the planet

Aligned with the United Nations plan to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals defined in its
2030 Agenda, we work every day to do more and do better to contribute to the health and quality of
life of people around the world.

The patients we serve are able to lead better lives. Patients inspire the work we do every day.

## Featured products

## VITROS^{™} Systems

VITROS^{™} systems enable fast, accurate and reliable results to help labs of every size achieve
operational and cost-efficiency objectives – today and into the future.

[ Learn more ][138]
[VITROS™ Systems]

## SOFIA^{™} Platform

Our SOFIA^{™} 2 Analyzer, the next generation in benchtop diagnostic testing, takes rapid testing to
the next level. Learn about our testing solutions with SOFIA.

[ Learn more ][139]
[SOFIA™ Platform]

## ORTHO^{™} Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer

QuidelOrtho's ORTHO^{™} Workstation is a scalable semi-automated immunohematology solution built
around proven column agglutination technology.

[ Learn more ][140]
[ORTHO™ Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer]

## ORTHO OPTIX^{™} Reader

When linked to the ORTHO^{™} Workstation, the ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader is a complete semi-automated
immunohematology testing solution for transfusion labs.

[ Learn more ][141]
[ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader - Semi-Automated Blood Bank Analyzer]

## LYRA^{™} Assays

Optimize your lab's workflow with QuidelOrtho LYRA^{™} real-time PCR assays, an open platform
solution for high-quality molecular testing.

[ Learn more ][142]
[LYRA™ Assays]

## QUICKVUE^{™} Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests

QUICKVUE^{™} rapid lateral-flow tests produce accurate results in minutes, allowing for faster
diagnoses, better-informed treatments and improved patient outcomes.

[ Learn more ][143]
[QUICKVUE™ Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests]

## TRIAGE^{™} System

QUIDEL^{™} TRIAGE^{™} System provides a reliable solution at the point-of-care for quick and easy
lab quality diagnostic results for a variety of immunoassays.

[ Learn more ][144]
[Triage® System]

## ORTHO VISION^{™} Swift Automated Immunohematology System

For dependably accurate and secure results, ORTHO VISION™ Swift and ORTHO VISION Swift Max analyzers
provide enhanced processing power, responsiveness and data security.

[ Learn more ][145]
[ORTHO VISION™ Swift Automated Immunohematology System]

## NULEXA^{™} System

The NULEXA^{™} System is an ultra-rapid real-time PCR molecular testing system that is designed to
deliver highly sensitive, multiplex testing for influenza A/B and COVID-19 directly from a swab
sample, in ten minutes or less.

[ Learn more ][146]
[NULEXA<sup>™</sup> System]

Caring for people, families and the communities where we live is what guides our work at

opportunity every day.

## Featured products

## VITROS^{™} Systems

VITROS^{™} systems enable fast, accurate and reliable results to help labs of every size achieve
operational and cost-efficiency objectives – today and into the future.

[ Learn more ][138]
[VITROS™ Systems]

## SOFIA^{™} Platform

Our SOFIA^{™} 2 Analyzer, the next generation in benchtop diagnostic testing, takes rapid testing to
the next level. Learn about our testing solutions with SOFIA.

[ Learn more ][139]
[SOFIA™ Platform]

## ORTHO^{™} Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer

QuidelOrtho's ORTHO^{™} Workstation is a scalable semi-automated immunohematology solution built
around proven column agglutination technology.

[ Learn more ][140]
[ORTHO™ Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer]

## ORTHO OPTIX^{™} Reader

When linked to the ORTHO^{™} Workstation, the ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader is a complete semi-automated
immunohematology testing solution for transfusion labs.

[ Learn more ][141]
[ORTHO OPTIX™ Reader - Semi-Automated Blood Bank Analyzer]

## LYRA^{™} Assays

Optimize your lab's workflow with QuidelOrtho LYRA^{™} real-time PCR assays, an open platform
solution for high-quality molecular testing.

[ Learn more ][142]
[LYRA™ Assays]

## QUICKVUE^{™} Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests

QUICKVUE^{™} rapid lateral-flow tests produce accurate results in minutes, allowing for faster
diagnoses, better-informed treatments and improved patient outcomes.

[ Learn more ][143]
[QUICKVUE™ Rapid Lateral-Flow Tests]

## TRIAGE^{™} System

QUIDEL^{™} TRIAGE^{™} System provides a reliable solution at the point-of-care for quick and easy
lab quality diagnostic results for a variety of immunoassays.

[ Learn more ][144]
[Triage® System]

## ORTHO VISION^{™} Swift Automated Immunohematology System

For dependably accurate and secure results, ORTHO VISION™ Swift and ORTHO VISION Swift Max analyzers
provide enhanced processing power, responsiveness and data security.

[ Learn more ][145]
[ORTHO VISION™ Swift Automated Immunohematology System]

## NULEXA^{™} System

The NULEXA^{™} System is an ultra-rapid real-time PCR molecular testing system that is designed to
deliver highly sensitive, multiplex testing for influenza A/B and COVID-19 directly from a swab
sample, in ten minutes or less.

[ Learn more ][146]
[NULEXA<sup>™</sup> System]

Privacy Overview

This website uses cookies so that we can provide you with the best user experience possible. Cookie
information is stored in your browser and performs functions such as recognizing you when you return
to our website and helping our team to understand which sections of the website you find most
interesting and useful.

Strictly Necessary Cookies

These cookies are required to move around a website and use its features, such as browsing as a
registered visitor, or making a purchase. Our website uses strictly necessary cookies. You may be
able to block these cookies through your browser settings, but some parts of the websites may not
function properly. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Enable or Disable Cookies Enabled Disabled
Performance cookies

These cookies collect information about how visitors use a website, such as the number of visitors
browsing the site or a particular section of the site, the pages visitors go to most often, and
whether they get error messages from web pages. These cookies do not collect information that
identifies a specific visitor. Rather, the information these cookies collect is aggregated and
therefore anonymous. The information that we gather through performance cookies is used to improve
how the websites work, to help us evaluate website usage, makes our marketing more relevant, and
improves your experience.

Tools that perform website analytics, such as Google Analytics, use performance cookies to generate
reports about a website's traffic and the sources of that traffic. They can also be used to
recognize you across platforms and devices. These tools tell website owners how many visitors came
to their website, and whether those visitors came to the website after clicking on a link in a
search engine or via another referral source. In this way, the website is able to evaluate website
traffic as well as the ways to increase website traffic. Like virtually all websites, we use
performance cookies, including Google Analytics.

Enable or Disable Cookies Enabled Disabled
Functional & Targeting cookies

Functional cookies: These cookies enable our website to remember choices made by website visitors
(such as user name, language or region) and provide enhanced, more personal features. They may be
set by us or by third-party providers whose services we have added to our website. This allows
websites to improve user experience. We use functional cookies.

Targeting cookies: These cookies are used to deliver online advertisements both on and off websites
visited that may be more relevant to visitor interests based on activity from a website being
browsed and based on a profile built of visitor interests. They may also be used to limit the number
of times visitors see an advertisement and to help measure the effectiveness of advertising
campaigns. We use targeting cookies. We do not serve third-party advertisements to you on our
websites. But, we do set targeting cookies on our sites to help us promote Quest’s products and
services to you on other sites and platforms. We also allow third parties to place cookies on our
websites, and information collected via these cookies is used to provide you with information that
may be of interest to you based on your activities on our websites. These targeting cookies do not
directly store personal information (such as names or email addresses), but store unique identifiers
that identify to us and our partners a particular visitor’s browser and/or device. Please visit
our [Privacy Statement][112] for more information about the cookies used across our websites and to
manage your cookie preferences where available.

Privacy Overview

This website uses cookies so that we can provide you with the best user experience possible. Cookie
information is stored in your browser and performs functions such as recognizing you when you return
to our website and helping our team to understand which sections of the website you find most
interesting and useful.

Strictly Necessary Cookies

These cookies are required to move around a website and use its features, such as browsing as a
registered visitor, or making a purchase. Our website uses strictly necessary cookies. You may be
able to block these cookies through your browser settings, but some parts of the websites may not
function properly. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Enable or Disable Cookies Enabled Disabled
Performance cookies

These cookies collect information about how visitors use a website, such as the number of visitors
browsing the site or a particular section of the site, the pages visitors go to most often, and
whether they get error messages from web pages. These cookies do not collect information that
identifies a specific visitor. Rather, the information these cookies collect is aggregated and
therefore anonymous. The information that we gather through performance cookies is used to improve
how the websites work, to help us evaluate website usage, makes our marketing more relevant, and
improves your experience.

Tools that perform website analytics, such as Google Analytics, use performance cookies to generate
reports about a website's traffic and the sources of that traffic. They can also be used to
recognize you across platforms and devices. These tools tell website owners how many visitors came
to their website, and whether those visitors came to the website after clicking on a link in a
search engine or via another referral source. In this way, the website is able to evaluate website
traffic as well as the ways to increase website traffic. Like virtually all websites, we use
performance cookies, including Google Analytics.

Enable or Disable Cookies Enabled Disabled
Functional & Targeting cookies

Functional cookies: These cookies enable our website to remember choices made by website visitors
(such as user name, language or region) and provide enhanced, more personal features. They may be
set by us or by third-party providers whose services we have added to our website. This allows
websites to improve user experience. We use functional cookies.

Targeting cookies: These cookies are used to deliver online advertisements both on and off websites
visited that may be more relevant to visitor interests based on activity from a website being
browsed and based on a profile built of visitor interests. They may also be used to limit the number
of times visitors see an advertisement and to help measure the effectiveness of advertising
campaigns. We use targeting cookies. We do not serve third-party advertisements to you on our
websites. But, we do set targeting cookies on our sites to help us promote Quest’s products and
services to you on other sites and platforms. We also allow third parties to place cookies on our
websites, and information collected via these cookies is used to provide you with information that
may be of interest to you based on your activities on our websites. These targeting cookies do not
directly store personal information (such as names or email addresses), but store unique identifiers
that identify to us and our partners a particular visitor’s browser and/or device. Please visit
our [Privacy Statement][112] for more information about the cookies used across our websites and to
manage your cookie preferences where available.

## *About Us*

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

## *About Us*

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

## Supporting Ebola Response: Rapid Diagnostics and Global Expertise

Advancing our commitment to public health, our teams are partnering to actively support Ebola
response efforts on the ground, expand diagnostic testing and strengthen laboratory capabilities.

[ Explore the Ebola Resource Hub ][207]

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

[ Discover Food & Quality Safety Solutions ][208]

## Annual Report: Achievements Building a Healthier Future

bioMérieux’s Annual Report highlights the achievements shaping public health, innovation, and
environmental responsibility for our future. From strengthening the fight against AMR and sepsis to
accelerating sustainable solutions, our work continues driving better outcomes for people, our
communities and the planet.

[ Explore the 2025 Annual Report ][209]

## Elevating Education Across the Diagnostic Pathway

The newly launched Product Education Hub deepens diagnostic understanding with evidence‑based
resources. Leverage scientific materials, webinars, symposium highlights, case studies, and more to
drive more informed clinical decision‑making.

* ## [ bioMérieux submits 510(k) to U.S. FDA for the latest versions of the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  ## Gastrointestinal Panels to enhance detection of gastrointestinal pathogens ][213]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today announces the submission of
  the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY® Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel and the BIOFIRE® FILMARRAY®
  Gastrointestinal 1.1 (GI1.1) Panel Mid to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for 510(k)
  review. These PCR* molecular panels test 22 and 11, respectively, of the most common bacteria,
  viruses, and parasites associated with gastroenteritis, all from one sample, with results
  available in approximately one hour.
  [ Discover more ][214]
* ## [ Advancing Women’s Health with Rapid Diagnostics: bioMérieux files a Dual 510(k) /CLIA Waiver
  ## application to the FDA for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE® Vaginitis Panel ][215]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, has submitted a Dual 510(k)/CLIA
  Waiver application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the BIOFIRE® SPOTFIRE®
  Vaginitis (VG) Panel. This automated, multiplex PCR test can simultaneously detect the most common
  causes of vaginitis in 20 minutes, directly at the point of care. With this submission, bioMérieux
  is intending to expand into women’s and sexual health, bringing rapid and accurate diagnostics
  closer to patients.
  [ Discover more ][216]
* ## [ bioMérieux introduces Salmonella testing kit on GENE-UP® TYPER to support root cause analysis
  ## in the food industry ][217]
  
  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today introduces the launch of
  GENE-UP® TYPER SLM, a new real-time PCR solution supporting rapid root cause analysis by
  discriminating Salmonella in the food industry environments.
  [ Discover more ][218]

Advancing our commitment to public health, our teams are partnering to actively support Ebola

## Protecting Food. Protecting People.

Safe food isn't just a privilege; it is a necessity. An estimated 600 million people fall ill after
eating contaminated food annually, with approximately 420,000 losing their lives. Efficient,
reliable and fast diagnostic solutions play a crucial role in safety, quality and protecting
consumers worldwide.

communities and the planet.

  bioMérieux, a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics, today announces the submission of

# Home Blood Tests

We've been helping the UK access laboratory tests from their home for over **15** years. Let us now
**help YOU.**

## Home Blood Testing Through Blue Horizon

Welcome to Blue Horizon. Since 2009, our website has enabled individuals to order home blood test
kits online for health screening, thyroid function, as well as many other health conditions. Dr

## Applying the power of science and technology

## to deliver innovation

## at the speed of life.

We’re Danaher - a leading global life sciences and diagnostics innovator, committed to accelerating
the power of science and technology to improve human health.

[A microscopic image of a cell]
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]
Our businesses
Biotechnology
[A microscopic image of a cell]

Advancements in healthcare and medicine are moving at an unprecedented pace with a promising
pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

In a world that’s ever-changing, our customers work to advance innovations that improve human
health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.           

[Learn about life sciences][68]

This is how Danaher brings innovation at the speed of life to the world—by connecting science,
accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

Danaher Business System

#### Act. Improve. Repeat.

Success at Danaher doesn't happen by accident. We have a proven system for achieving it called the
Danaher Business System (DBS). DBS guides every aspect of our culture and performance. It’s how we
consistently turn ideas into impact—helping our businesses move faster, collaborate more
effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

[See the DBS impact][69]
[Acceleration, momentum pattern]

### Bringing new possibilities to life

Our collaborative approach means we solve the hardest problems—together—with customers and partners
around the world.

#### Innovative mindset

Curiosity and continuous improvement are at Danaher’s core. We want to learn more, find new
solutions, and deliver better results. 

[See how we work][70]

#### Initiatives

We’re determined to break down silos and unite bright minds across academia and industry. Our
partnership initiatives are designed to do just that.

[See current initiatives][71]

#### Acquisitions

From adding exciting new technologies to contributing new perspectives and skills to our extended
team, our focused acquisition strategy is essential as we accelerate the power of science and
technology to help our customers, our companies and our shareholders.

[Learn about acquisitions][72]

## Applying the power of science and technology

## to deliver innovation

## at the speed of life.

We’re Danaher - a leading global life sciences and diagnostics innovator, committed to accelerating
the power of science and technology to improve human health.

[A microscopic image of a cell]
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]
Our businesses
Biotechnology
[A microscopic image of a cell]

Advancements in healthcare and medicine are moving at an unprecedented pace with a promising
pipeline of innovative drugs on the horizon that are more targeted, personalized, and effective than
ever before. Our biotechnology business brings expertise, technologies, and services that accelerate
the development and commercialization of these life-changing therapies, ensuring that they can be
delivered quickly and safely to the patients who need them.

[Learn about biotechnology][66]
Diagnostics
[A male doctor talks with a patient in a meeting room]

There is an urgent need for better, more expansive health care—and we’re ready to meet it. Our
diagnostics businesses create tools and software designed to improve confidence in precise and rapid
diagnoses.

[Learn about diagnostics ][67]
Life Sciences
[Zoomed in image of a petri dish]

In a world that’s ever-changing, our customers work to advance innovations that improve human
health. Our life sciences businesses power tools and technologies that support our customers in a
wide range of critical activities, whether it’s creating breakthrough cell and gene therapies,
ensuring high-quality fluid filtration in labs, or driving the latest advances in molecular
oncology.           

[Learn about life sciences][68]

This is how Danaher brings innovation at the speed of life to the world—by connecting science,
accelerating progress, and delivering impact at global scale.

Danaher Business System

#### Act. Improve. Repeat.

Success at Danaher doesn't happen by accident. We have a proven system for achieving it called the
Danaher Business System (DBS). DBS guides every aspect of our culture and performance. It’s how we
consistently turn ideas into impact—helping our businesses move faster, collaborate more
effectively, and deliver results with quality and certainty at scale.

[See the DBS impact][69]
[Acceleration, momentum pattern]

### Bringing new possibilities to life

Our collaborative approach means we solve the hardest problems—together—with customers and partners
around the world.

#### Innovative mindset

Curiosity and continuous improvement are at Danaher’s core. We want to learn more, find new
solutions, and deliver better results. 

[See how we work][70]

#### Initiatives

We’re determined to break down silos and unite bright minds across academia and industry. Our
partnership initiatives are designed to do just that.

[See current initiatives][71]

#### Acquisitions

From adding exciting new technologies to contributing new perspectives and skills to our extended
team, our focused acquisition strategy is essential as we accelerate the power of science and
technology to help our customers, our companies and our shareholders.

[Learn about acquisitions][72]

#### Science & Innovation

We enable breakthrough science and technology within our businesses by looking beyond current
products and platforms to create the technologies and applications that will become the foundation
of tomorrow’s successes.

[Learn about our science][73]

From our environment to our associates, we’re determined to create positive impact that accelerates
greater progress.

[Read the 2026 Sustainability Report][74]

## Screen for 50+ cancers with a single blood test

The Galleri^{®} multi-cancer early detection test identifies DNA in the bloodstream shed by cancer
cells^{1 }and does not predict future genetic risk for cancer. 

HSA/FSA eligible*

[ Request the test ][45]

The Galleri test does not detect a signal for all cancers, and false positive or false negative
results can occur.

*Check with your plan to confirm eligibility

[2024 compilation]
Play Video Cookie notice ⓘ

## Now there’s a proactive tool to screen for cancer

The Galleri test can be taken annually as a simple blood test and screens for a “fingerprint” of
many of the deadliest cancers before they become symptomatic, including those with no recommended
screening tests today.^{1,2,3}

[ About the Galleri test ][46]
[ What does Galleri screen for? ][47]

The Galleri test does not detect a signal for all cancers, and false positive or false negative
results can occur. The Galleri test should be used in addition to healthcare provider recommended
screening tests.

## OUR MISSION  

# Detect cancer early,
# when it can be cured.

[ About GRAIL ][50]
[

##### NEWS CENTER

][51] [

##### PATIENT STORIES

][52] [

##### CLINICAL EVIDENCE

][53]

## The Galleri^{®} Test

### A multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test

Capable of screening for cancers before they become symptomatic, including those that don’t have
recommended screening tests today.

The Galleri test does not detect a signal for all cancers and not all cancers can be detected in the
blood. False positive and false negative results do occur.

[ Learn more ][54]
[mced blood test vial]
[grail scientist]

## Recent News

#### [ Priority Health Collaborates With GRAIL as the First Michigan Health Plan to Offer the
#### Galleri^{®} Multi-Cancer Early Detection Blood Test to Employer Plans ][55]

July 16, 2026

#### [ GRAIL Completes $110 Million Equity Financing With Samsung Entities ][56]

June 25, 2026

#### [ GRAIL Presents PATHFINDER 2 Results of More Than 35,000 Participants Showing the
#### Galleri^{®} Test Substantially Increased Cancer Detection With Robust Performance and Favorable
#### Safety at 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting ][57]

May 31, 2026

## “There's nothing in my family history that had me concerned for cancer...”

Kevin, a healthy firefighter of 30 years, took a multi-cancer early detection test offered by his
fire department. Watch his inspring story.

[ Full story ][58]
[mced laboratory]

## The Science Behind Multi-Cancer Early Detection

### A new approach to screening for cancer

Multi-cancer early detection (MCED) represents a new frontier in cancer screening—using a simple
blood test to identify signals from more than 50 types of cancer, including those without existing
routine screening options.

[ Learn more ][59]
[cancer signal podcast logo]

### The Cancer SIGNAL Podcast

On this podcast, we explore the stories behind multi-cancer early detection—from patients to
doctors, researchers to advocates, and more.

[ Listen now ][60]

Stay up to date on the latest news from GRAIL by signing up for our newsletter.

## OUR MISSION  

# Detect cancer early,
# when it can be cured.

[ About GRAIL ][50]
[

##### NEWS CENTER

][51] [

##### PATIENT STORIES

][52] [

##### CLINICAL EVIDENCE

][53]

## The Galleri^{®} Test

### A multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test

Capable of screening for cancers before they become symptomatic, including those that don’t have
recommended screening tests today.

The Galleri test does not detect a signal for all cancers and not all cancers can be detected in the
blood. False positive and false negative results do occur.

[ Learn more ][54]
[mced blood test vial]
[grail scientist]

## Recent News

#### [ Priority Health Collaborates With GRAIL as the First Michigan Health Plan to Offer the
#### Galleri^{®} Multi-Cancer Early Detection Blood Test to Employer Plans ][55]

July 16, 2026

#### [ GRAIL Completes $110 Million Equity Financing With Samsung Entities ][56]

June 25, 2026

#### [ GRAIL Presents PATHFINDER 2 Results of More Than 35,000 Participants Showing the
#### Galleri^{®} Test Substantially Increased Cancer Detection With Robust Performance and Favorable
#### Safety at 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting ][57]

May 31, 2026

## “There's nothing in my family history that had me concerned for cancer...”

Kevin, a healthy firefighter of 30 years, took a multi-cancer early detection test offered by his
fire department. Watch his inspring story.

[ Full story ][58]
[mced laboratory]

## The Science Behind Multi-Cancer Early Detection

### A new approach to screening for cancer

Multi-cancer early detection (MCED) represents a new frontier in cancer screening—using a simple
blood test to identify signals from more than 50 types of cancer, including those without existing
routine screening options.

[ Learn more ][59]
[cancer signal podcast logo]

### The Cancer SIGNAL Podcast

On this podcast, we explore the stories behind multi-cancer early detection—from patients to
doctors, researchers to advocates, and more.

[ Listen now ][60]

**“Service, Quality and Reliable”**

###### WELCOME TO JAL INNOVATION (SINGAPORE) PTE LTD

[Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits, STD Test Kits, Blood Glucose Monitoring Systems Manufacturer ]

# **Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits and Blood Glucose Monitoring Systems Manufacturer & Distributor**

JAL Medical Singapore Group of Companies (JAL Medical & JAL Innovation) rapid diagnostic test kits
manufacturer, and one of the diagnostic companies in Singapore, is a subsidiary of OK Biotech Co.
Ltd., a publicly traded company. Company’s headquarter’s is in Hsinchu, Taiwan. We have , ISO 13485,
and GMP certifications. Our overall purpose is to provide a fully centralized biomedicine production
plant that offers a full variety of patented diabetes testing devices and in-vitro screening testing
kits to our partners around the world.

The JAL Medical Business unit has been in the healthcare industry for 20 years and is now recognised
as being among the world’s finest manufacturers and worldwide distributors of quick diagnostics test
kits. The firm a rapid testing companies is also a world’s largest producer of blood glucose
monitoring equipment.

We as a vitro diagnostics company are dedicated to serving our stakeholders by creating and
distributing high-quality, dependable, and economical commodities / services throughout all
continents. Our mission is to deliver efficient, dependable, and cost-effective products in
international market.
**Our Group’s Key Business Divisions are:**
* Manufacturing of a wide range of Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits, drug testing kits, in-vitro
  diagnostic kits, Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Test, Chlamydia Rapid Screen Test, biotech test kit,
  including a comprehensive line of STD test kits , Menopause Test Kits, etc. for professional and
  personal usage.
* Production of a wide range of blood glucose monitoring systems for professional and personal
  usage.
* Experienced Consulting for the Development and Manufacturing of Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits
* Health Supplements – The Company has teamed up with Nutrisyz Singapore to create and market an
  intriguing line of innovative medicine and herbal-based health products throughout the world. The
  Singapore Health Science Authority has authorised and listed this high-efficacy Chinese
  Proprietary Medical (CPM) (HSA).

[Biomedical Solutions, Healthcare ]

## Latest News of JAL Medical Group of Companies

We are glad to report that the JAL Medical Group of Companies (JAL Medical Singapore & JAL
Innovation Singapore), in collaboration with our South African partner Armada Diagnostics Pty Ltd,
has consistently won the South African National Department of Health from 2014 to 2023.

We are delivering our co-branded WHO pre-qualified HIV 1&2 testing kits as part of a united
collective collaboration. We are quite pleased to report that we have won the third contract in a
row.

These contracts are believed to be the biggest global delivery of diagnostic test kits.  Throughout
those years, about 65 million diagnostic test kits were provided and effectively deployed. We intend
to provide further 42 million diagnostic test kits under the revised tender allotment from 2021 to
2023.

Furthermore, JAL Medical Singapore has a substantial market share for our iCare Advanced blood
glucose screening devices in Laos, Ivory Coast, Nigeria, and Indonesia, to mention a few countries.

Our rapid diagnostics STD test kits for domestic use are provided to essential projects in Myanmar,
Laos, New Zealand, Equatorial New Guinea, Thailand, and other Pacific and Caribbean Islands.

The international prosperity has been aided by our great teamwork, strong brand image, constant
quality of products, and excellent services.

We’d like to sincerely thank all of our international clients for their contributions to our success
over the last 20 years.

Prescription help

## Have a prescription but not sure which tests to add?

Patients can search the catalog directly, or share prescription details during checkout so the JCRL
team can confirm the right test names before collection.

[Add tests from catalog][52][Email prescription][53]
[Patient handing prescription to a diagnostic care professional]

## Home collection without losing laboratory control.

JCRL's process makes collection easier for patients while protecting the integrity of the sample
from pickup to testing.

1

#### Sample collected by trained staff

A qualified phlebotomist visits your home.

2

#### Transported in designed packets

Secure logistics protect sample integrity.

3

#### Tested at NABL central lab

Quality control monitoring at every stage.

4

#### Report delivered online

Secure, fast, and reviewed by pathologists.

[Book Home Collection][54]
[JCRL home collection visit with sample preparation]

Technology Matters

Advanced laboratory platforms support biochemistry, immunoassay, hematology, and molecular
workflows.

## Why patients, families, and partners trust JCRL

The value of a diagnostics network lies in consistency: trained handling, disciplined quality
systems, responsive service, and results that can be relied upon.

#### NABL-aligned quality discipline

Quality systems, review protocols, and laboratory control help maintain confidence in every report.

#### Careful sample movement

Transport and handling matter because sample integrity affects the final result.

#### Secure report access

Patients can retrieve reports digitally while still receiving support when clarification is needed.

#### Experienced laboratory oversight

Scientific supervision and professional review remain central to the reporting process.

## Specialised departments within the JCRL laboratory system

A serious diagnostics network depends on focused departments, appropriate analytical methods, and
trained scientific teams working within clear laboratory boundaries.

[Explore Our Quality ][55]

### Molecular Diagnostics

Supports high-sensitivity work such as infectious marker analysis and specialised molecular
investigations where routine methods are not sufficient.

RT-PCRViral Load HCV/HBVHLA-B27

### Biochemistry

Handles routine and specialised chemistry testing for organ function, metabolic balance, and
broad-profile screening needs.

Kidney ProfileLiver FunctionElectrolytes

### Immunology

Supports hormone testing, vitamin studies, tumor markers, and serology through platform-specific
analytical methods.

Thyroid PanelVitamin DTumor Markers

### Histopathology

Provides tissue-based diagnostic support where microscopic examination is essential for deeper
clinical assessment.

BiopsiesCytologyIHC

### Hematology

Supports blood counts, coagulation review, and advanced blood-cell analysis for routine and
specialised diagnostic needs.

CBC AnalysisCoagulation ProfileHbA1c

### Microbiology

Supports culture-driven and infection-focused testing where organism detection and sensitivity
patterns are clinically important.

Urine CultureBlood CultureFungal Smear

## Support designed around three kinds of trust

JCRL serves patients, clinicians, and partner centres with different needs, but the same expectation
of reliability.

1

### For patients

Clear booking pathways, home collection support, digital report access, and assistance when test
names or preparation steps are unclear.

Verified against JCRL service scope

2

### For doctors

A broad test menu, structured laboratory workflows, and a diagnostics partner that values scientific
clarity and responsiveness.

Verified against JCRL service scope

3

### For partners

Operational support, logistics, consumables, training, and a laboratory backbone designed for
network reliability.

Verified against JCRL service scope

Leadership behind JCRL

## An organisation earns credibility through people, standards, and continuity.

JCRL's direction is shaped by leadership that balances laboratory discipline, operational
seriousness, and a sustained commitment to patient trust.

[Dr. Simpi Rani, Director Laboratory, JCRL Diagnostics]

“Every diagnostic result carries a duty of care. Our responsibility is to make that process clear,
careful, and professionally accountable.”

### Dr. Simpi Rani

Director Laboratory, JCRL Diagnostics

[Mr. Sanjeev Mishra, Managing Director, JCRL Diagnostics]

“A diagnostics network becomes dependable when service, logistics, reporting, and operational
discipline improve together over time.”

### Mr. Sanjeev Mishra

Managing Director, JCRL Diagnostics

[Doctor and patient discussing diagnostic care]

Start with the service route that fits you best, whether that means booking online, arranging home

## Home collection without losing laboratory control.

JCRL's process makes collection easier for patients while protecting the integrity of the sample
from pickup to testing.

1

#### Sample collected by trained staff

A qualified phlebotomist visits your home.

2

#### Transported in designed packets

Secure logistics protect sample integrity.

3

#### Tested at NABL central lab

Quality control monitoring at every stage.

4

#### Report delivered online

Secure, fast, and reviewed by pathologists.

[Book Home Collection][54]
[JCRL home collection visit with sample preparation]

Technology Matters

Advanced laboratory platforms support biochemistry, immunoassay, hematology, and molecular
workflows.

## Why patients, families, and partners trust JCRL

The value of a diagnostics network lies in consistency: trained handling, disciplined quality
systems, responsive service, and results that can be relied upon.

#### NABL-aligned quality discipline

Quality systems, review protocols, and laboratory control help maintain confidence in every report.

#### Careful sample movement

Transport and handling matter because sample integrity affects the final result.

#### Secure report access

Patients can retrieve reports digitally while still receiving support when clarification is needed.

#### Experienced laboratory oversight

Scientific supervision and professional review remain central to the reporting process.

## Specialised departments within the JCRL laboratory system

A serious diagnostics network depends on focused departments, appropriate analytical methods, and
trained scientific teams working within clear laboratory boundaries.

[Explore Our Quality ][55]

### Molecular Diagnostics

Supports high-sensitivity work such as infectious marker analysis and specialised molecular
investigations where routine methods are not sufficient.

RT-PCRViral Load HCV/HBVHLA-B27

### Biochemistry

Handles routine and specialised chemistry testing for organ function, metabolic balance, and
broad-profile screening needs.

Kidney ProfileLiver FunctionElectrolytes

### Immunology

Supports hormone testing, vitamin studies, tumor markers, and serology through platform-specific
analytical methods.

Thyroid PanelVitamin DTumor Markers

### Histopathology

Provides tissue-based diagnostic support where microscopic examination is essential for deeper
clinical assessment.

BiopsiesCytologyIHC

### Hematology

Supports blood counts, coagulation review, and advanced blood-cell analysis for routine and
specialised diagnostic needs.

CBC AnalysisCoagulation ProfileHbA1c

### Microbiology

Supports culture-driven and infection-focused testing where organism detection and sensitivity
patterns are clinically important.

Urine CultureBlood CultureFungal Smear

## Support designed around three kinds of trust

JCRL serves patients, clinicians, and partner centres with different needs, but the same expectation
of reliability.

1

### For patients

Clear booking pathways, home collection support, digital report access, and assistance when test
names or preparation steps are unclear.

Verified against JCRL service scope

2

### For doctors

A broad test menu, structured laboratory workflows, and a diagnostics partner that values scientific
clarity and responsiveness.

Verified against JCRL service scope

3

### For partners

Operational support, logistics, consumables, training, and a laboratory backbone designed for
network reliability.

Verified against JCRL service scope

seriousness, and a sustained commitment to patient trust.

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

Oncology

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path
to better outcomes for patients. 

[ Learn More ][221]

Biopharma

### Scientifically rigorous, extensive in scale

Our global lab footprint, vast clinical data and scientific expertise help accelerate the drug
development process.

[ Learn More ][222]
[Labcorp biopharma technician evaluating samples]

Labcorp OnDemand

### Stop wondering. Go test yourself.

Explore over 50 self-ordered lab tests and get answers about your health.

[ Shop All Tests ][223]

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path
to better outcomes for patients. 

[ Learn More ][221]

# Payments, tax & subscriptions for software companies

Selling digital downloads, subscriptions, and software licenses has never been easier, faster, or
more secure.

[
Get started
][32]

## trusted by thousands of companies globally

why lemon squeezy?

## Lemon Squeezy is the all-in-one platform for running your SaaS business. Payments, subscriptions,
## global tax compliance, fraud prevention, multi-currency support, failed payment recovery, PayPal
## integration and more. We make running your software business easy peasy.

01

### Global tax compliance

We’re your merchant of record. That means **we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax**
without you lifting a finger.

02

### Borderless SaaS payments

Instantly sell your digital products around the globe. As your merchant of record, you can **accept
payments from 135+ countries** right out of the box with zero setup.

03

### Instant payment methods

Our no-code and API solutions **support 20+ payment methods**, and we offer bank payouts globally.

04

### Local currency support

Offer your products in your local currency to **increase checkout conversions**. Lemon Squeezy
currency support spans 130+ countries.

05

### A.I. fraud prevention

Using real-time AI to detect anomalous patterns across signups, logins, refunds, and other actions,
**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

06

### Failed payment recovery

Lemon Squeezy offers a **powerful dunning management system** to combat involuntary churn from
subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

ecommerce

## Create the perfect buying experience for your customers

Launch your secure ecommerce website and start selling software, subscriptions and digital downloads
anywhere in minutes. **Utilize no-code checkout links** without worrying about design, mobile
optimization, or payment integrations. It really is easy-peasy.

[
e/1

### Accept online payments

Don't worry about merchant accounts and billing logic. **Choose per seat, usage-based and more**.
Customize as little or as much as you like.

][33][
e/2

### Recurring billing + subscriptions

Charge customers on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis. **Manage upgrades, downgrades, and
cancels**. Offer free trials, discounts, and more.

][34][
e/3

### License key management

Automatically issue license keys for your software and apps after each sale. **Deactivate, re-issue,
and have full control** over license management.

][35][
e/4

### Sell digital downloads

Anyone can provide download links, but what about security and abuse? Your **download links are
securely signed**, throttled, and more.

][36][
e/5

### No-code checkout forms

No matter what you use for your website, you can **embed your checkout** or **share your unique
checkout links** and sell anywhere.

][37][
e/6

### Launch your ecommerce store

Build an ecommerce website in minutes **without coding or design skills**. Customizable, SSL secured
and mobile-optimized as standard.

][38]
marketing

## Grow your business with integrated marketing tools

Grow your audience, build long-lasting customer relationships, and make more sales with **powerful,
easy-to-use marketing tools**. Whether you need to offer discount codes or you want to build your
email list, you can do it all with Lemon Squeezy.

[
M/1

We’re your merchant of record. That means **we handle payments, merchant fees, fraud and sales tax**

Instantly sell your digital products around the globe. As your merchant of record, you can **accept

**Lemon Squeezy protects you from malicious attacks**.

subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

Natera’s cell-free DNA tests help inform more personalized health care decisions.

[Protect Health and Enable Earlier, More Targeted Interventions]
[Protect Health and Enable Earlier, More Targeted Interventions]

[Know]

[Decide]

#### Decide

Make more-informed health decisions for individualized care.

## Dedicated to Oncology, Women’s Health, Organ Health, and Rare Disease

[Oncology Tests video thumbnail]

### Oncology Tests

Characterize tumors, anticipate risk, and evaluate treatment response earlier than traditional
tools. Hear Jeff’s story.

[Learn More][175]

[Women’s Health Tests video thumbnail]

### Women’s Health Tests

Identify risk of severe genetic conditions to help families prepare and inform early intervention
that can improve outcomes. Hear Corrine’s story.

[Learn More][176]

[Organ Health Tests video thumbnail]

### Organ Health Tests

Detect organ injury early and inform treatment strategy to improve transplant health. Hear Gigi’s
story.

[Learn More][177]

## Innovating with Integrity

## Innovating with Integrity

Natera advances molecular diagnostics with integrity and scientific rigor, and supports integration
of information provided by our tests into health care decision making. Our tests are clinically
validated in over 400 peer-reviewed publications with over 3 million patients studied.

We participated in the largest prospective studies to date in molecular diagnostics in oncology
([CIRCULATE][178]), women’s health ([SMART][179]), and organ health ([Trifecta][180]). We meet or
exceed applicable industry and regulatory standards for all of our tests to deliver high-quality
results, and have processed over 16 million tests in our CAP/CLIA‑certified labs.

We have more than 150 medical professionals on staff who provide expert support to help make our
test results clear and easy to understand.

# We believe in the power of science to transform our world.

Together with scientists and operators worldwide, we empower progress by providing trusted insights
and services that accelerate work and amplify impact for a healthier, safer, and more sustainable
world.

[Biopharma][240] [Applied Solutions][241] [Food Solutions][242]


# We drive efficiency and empower sustainable scientific discovery with nearly 90 years of
# pioneering innovation.

[Discover More][243]


## By your side, globally.

Offices in 35 countries.

Customers served in 168 countries (direct and through distributors).

Manufacturing presence in North-America, Europe and APAC, incl. China.


## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,
creativity, and passion of our people.

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

[Explore Careers][244]

[Shop Now][245]

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

ProvenExpert provides you with industry-specific customer surveys, perfectly tailored to your

per survey. Gain valuable feedback and boost your online reputation - whether you are a financial
advisor, hairdresser, painter or trainer.

Stay in control of your reviews - with ProvenExpert, you can centralize all your [customer reviews –
including the number of reviews and your overall rating – in one place. Receive real-time

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.

# RETSCH - Milling & Sieving

Retsch is the leading manufacturer of laboratory mills, jaw crushers and sieving equipment. With
more than 100 years of experience, Retsch develops innovative solutions for neutral-to-analysis
sample preparation and particle size analysis. Trusted by researchers and quality control
laboratories around the world, Retsch products are defined by excellent performance, ease of use,
safety and a long lifetime. As the market and technology leader, we are offering the most
comprehensive range of equipment.

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]
01 / 23

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation
][162]

## Partners for medicine and research

We believe that tailored innovation and collaborative partnership are the keys to the best possible
healthcare for all. Therefore, we consistently place the needs of medical and research professionals
at the center of our work, just as much as the perspective of patients.

In our pursuit of optimal solutions, we are in close dialogue worldwide with our customers and are
genuinely interested in your needs. For we are convinced that successful partnership leads to mutual
and sustainable growth.

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation

We believe that tailored innovation and collaborative partnership are the keys to the best possible
healthcare for all. Therefore, we consistently place the needs of medical and research professionals
at the center of our work, just as much as the perspective of patients.

In our pursuit of optimal solutions, we are in close dialogue worldwide with our customers and are
genuinely interested in your needs. For we are convinced that successful partnership leads to mutual
and sustainable growth.

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

### What areas do you cover?

We provide clinic appointments at our Billericay location and partner clinics across the UK. Home
visits are available throughout Essex, Bromley and Surrey. If you’re unsure whether we cover your
area, contact us and we’ll confirm availability.

### Are your phlebotomists qualified?

Yes — all of our phlebotomists are fully trained, experienced, and qualified to carry out safe and
professional blood collection. We work under strict clinical standards and are CQC registered for
quality and safety.

### Can I book a blood test without a referral from my doctor?

Yes — you do not need a GP referral to book a private blood test with Swift Blood Tests. You can
choose from our wide range of tests and book directly online or by phone.

### How soon will I get my results?

Most results are available within 24–48 hours. Some specialist tests may take a little longer, but
you will always be informed of the expected turnaround time when booking.

### Do I need a referral from my GP to book a blood test?

> No. Most of our private blood tests can be booked without a GP referral. Simply choose the test
> you need, book online, and attend your appointment or arrange a home visit. If you’re unsure which
> test is right for you, our team is happy to help.

 

### How will I receive my results?

Results are delivered securely by email or via our online portal. If you’d like, we can also arrange
a follow-up consultation to explain your results and next steps.

### Are my blood test results confidential?

Yes. Your results are handled securely and confidentially in line with UK data protection
regulations. They are shared only with you unless you request that they be sent to your GP or
another healthcare professional.

### No more painful needles.
### No more phlebotomy.
### **Elevate your patient experience.**

### The Process that Patients Prefer

Unlock a proven patient experience without painful needles or finger sticks.

*Internal data on file

  ## painless. If I can do it, anyone can!”

  ## done. It’s totally pain free and was done in literal minutes.”

# Understand your lab tests, understand your health

At Testing.com, we help consumers advocate for their health by providing them with learning guides
and products that make lab testing accessible, convenient and affordable.

Hundreds of easy-to-read lab testing guides. Confidential, secure and convenient online lab test
ordering powered by direct access to our laboratory partners. Compassionate customer support. We
combine expert-reviewed lab test information with access to hundreds of in-lab and at-home tests.

Testing.com is supported by readers and we may also earn commissions through products purchased
using links on this page. You can read more about how we make money [here][50].

## How it Works

### It’s all about the data.

Lab testing provides the data you need to build and maintain a care plan that is as custom and
convenient as possible. Read over 400 expert-reviewed lab test guides to better understand what each
test measures, how it’s used, when you might need a particular test, and more.

[View Testing Guides][52]

### Turn information into action.

If you need a test, order lab tests and at-home test kits through our laboratory partners directly.
We partner with certified labs to give you the most reliable and secure experience possible.

[How it Works Image 2]

### Make informed health care decisions

Most results are ready 1-2 days after samples are received at the laboratory. Your results will be
accessible through the partnering laboratory or company that your order is processed through.

[View Resources][53]

Your results are a starting point, not the finish line. Our expert-reviewed treatment guides walk
through the options, from GLP-1 medications for weight and blood sugar to sermorelin and NAD+ for
energy and recovery.

### [Reference Ranges and What They Mean][91]

A reference range is a set of values that includes upper and lower limits of a lab test based on a
group of otherwise healthy people. By comparing your test results with reference values, you and
your health care provider can see if any of your test results fall outside the range of expected
values and gain clues to help identify possible conditions or diseases.

[Learn More][92]

## Latest News

May 16, 2022

## Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria Cause More Deaths than HIV or Malaria

A new global report found that more people died of infections caused by antibiotic-resistant
bacteria than HIV or malaria in 2019. Bacterial infections that don’t respond to antibiotic
treatment are a serious public health threat. Misuse and overuse of antibiotics have contributed to
this increasing worldwide problem.

[bacteria]
**Antibiotic Resistance in Bacteria**

Antibiotic resistance is when bacteria are able to survive and grow in the presence of one or more
antibiotics.

### [Reference Ranges and What They Mean][91]

A reference range is a set of values that includes upper and lower limits of a lab test based on a
group of otherwise healthy people. By comparing your test results with reference values, you and
your health care provider can see if any of your test results fall outside the range of expected
values and gain clues to help identify possible conditions or diseases.

[Learn More][92]

## Latest News

May 16, 2022

## Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria Cause More Deaths than HIV or Malaria

A new global report found that more people died of infections caused by antibiotic-resistant
bacteria than HIV or malaria in 2019. Bacterial infections that don’t respond to antibiotic
treatment are a serious public health threat. Misuse and overuse of antibiotics have contributed to
this increasing worldwide problem.

[bacteria]
**Antibiotic Resistance in Bacteria**

Antibiotic resistance is when bacteria are able to survive and grow in the presence of one or more
antibiotics.

# Browse Privately.

# Explore Freely.

### Defend yourself against tracking and surveillance. Circumvent censorship.

[ Download Tor Browser ][36]
[Block Trackers]

#### BLOCK TRACKERS

Tor Browser isolates each website you visit so third-party trackers and ads can't follow you. Any
cookies automatically clear when you're done browsing. So will your browsing history.

[Defend Against Surveillance]

#### DEFEND AGAINST SURVEILLANCE

Tor Browser prevents someone watching your connection from knowing what websites you visit. All
anyone monitoring your browsing habits can see is that you're using Tor.

[Resist Fingerprinting]

#### RESIST FINGERPRINTING

Tor Browser aims to make all users look the same, making it difficult for you to be fingerprinted
based on your browser and device information.

[Multi-layered Encryption]

#### MULTI-LAYERED ENCRYPTION

Your traffic is relayed and encrypted three times as it passes over the Tor network. The network is
comprised of thousands of volunteer-run servers known as Tor relays.

[Browse Freely]

#### BROWSE FREELY

With Tor Browser, you are free to access sites your home network may have blocked.

We believe everyone should be able to explore the internet with privacy. We are the Tor Project, a
501(c)(3) US nonprofit. We advance human rights and defend your privacy online through free software
and open networks. [Meet our team][37].

Download Tor Browser to experience real private browsing without tracking, surveillance, or
censorship.

scientific and popular understanding.

US MED^{®} is America's primary choice for home delivery of quality medical supplies. Since 1996,
over 1 million satisfied members have received disease state education and medical supplies from our
highly trained customer service specialists. US MED^{®}, the largest provider of Diabetic Supplies
to the Medicare community, is licensed and accredited by Accreditation Commission for Health Care
(ACHC) and maintains an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau. We provide all products necessary
to treat the [Diabetes disease][141] state, including therapies for its associated comorbidities.
Our product portfolio includes, but is not limited to, the following: [Diabetic testing
strips][142], [Continuous Glucose Monitors or CGMs][143], Insulin Pumps, Sleep Apnea and CPAP
supplies, and Nebulizers.
